# Synthetic Office test files

[Deutsch](README.md) · **English** · [← Development](../../../docs/DEVELOPMENT.en.md)

These six files contain only invented test text, umlauts and a sample summation. They test Writer, Calc and Impress through to readable PDF output.

`sample.docx`, `sample.xlsx` and `sample.pptx` were generated with python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx respectively. The OpenDocument variants were exported from these files using LibreOffice. Running the tests requires no additional generation libraries.

All files are test material belonging to this project and contain no user documents or credentials.
